name: Search messages
description: Search mailbox messages by Internet Message-ID and/or NetworkMessageId. At least one identifier is required; use List messages in a folder to find messages without an identifier.

email_local_id.description: NetworkMessageId mapped from email.local_id. Provide this or Email Message Id. This is not the Graph item ID returned as message_id.

email_message_id.description: Internet Message-ID mapped from email.message_id, with or without angle brackets. Provide this or Email Local Id. This is not the Graph item ID returned as message_id.

max_messages_to_return.description: The maximum number of messages to return

return_most_recent_first.description: The option to return candidates sorted by receivedDateTime descending when true

user.description: The user identifier or user principal name (UPN)

error_details.description: Safe structured errors. retryable refers to retrying the whole action; it is false after a modifying request.

has_more.description: The indicator that is true when Graph indicates additional pages may exist

message_ids.description: The list of Microsoft Graph message item IDs extracted from returned messages

message_id.description: The Microsoft Graph message item ID

network_message_id.description: The NetworkMessageId extracted from Graph extended properties when available

parent_folder_id.description: The Graph parent folder ID at retrieval time.

outcome.description: Overall action outcome. Partial, failed and unknown outcomes also flag an SDK action error; inspect retained results before retrying.

query_type.description: The identifier type used for the search

query_value.description: The search identifier value, or concatenated values when both identifiers are provided

returned_count.description: The alias of total_results for explicit count-based playbook conditions

scan_limit_reached.description: The indicator that is true when fallback scanning stops at the max scanned-messages budget

total_results.description: The number of messages returned in this response

user.description: The echo of the user identifier used for this action, reusable in downstream playbook nodes
